Maya K: Quick arch check — we're planning a deadline-cutover for the gateway on Wed. Main concern: if a rolling deploy causes a midstream model swap, how do we avoid duplicate tokens / double-sends to upstream or clients? What should own finality and retries for streaming calls?

Jonah: Two axes to decide: who owns response-finality (edge vs upstream) and what retry primitives we expose. If edge owns finality it needs to dedupe by request-id + offset. For streaming we can either (A) resume tokens, or (B) explicit checkpoint trailers.

Lia P: Resume tokens worked in proto but got messy with backpressure + KV cache eviction. Checkpoint trailers are simpler for short-lived streams, but don’t help long reconnects.

Samir: I'd advocate for an opaque resume token that encodes model-version + offset + last-ack-hash. Edge verifies HMAC so we avoid server-side state in the common case. Example header/trailer:

```
X-Resume-Token: eyJtZC12IjoiMi4wIiwib2Zmc2V0IjoxMjMsImhhc2giOiJ..."```

Maya K: Makes sense. Token should include model-version, architecture id, offset, and a short TTL. Also add a nonce to prevent replay with same offset.

infra-bot: deploy-bot started canary rollout for gateway v2 at 1768009900 :rocket:

Jonah: Important: edge must refuse to resume if model-arch or quantization mode mismatch (return 409 + clear resume instructions). Otherwise resumed tokens could produce incoherent outputs.

Lia P: Tradeoffs: signed token avoids persistent mapping (good for scale). Persistent mapping (Redis) gives revocation and long-lived sessions but costs memory and operational complexity. We should measure typical session lifetime.

Samir: Concrete proposal: signed HMAC token with TTL 30s as default. If a session is marked long-lived (e.g., interactive > 15m) create a server-side mapping keyed by token-hash and store metadata (model-version, tenant, expiry). Docs stub: /docs/streaming/resume-token.md (WIP).

Maya K: Action items: Samir to draft token spec (shape, fields, HMAC scheme), Jonah to add compatibility checks in edge (model-version/arch), Lia to run memory perf of persistent mapping vs stateless tokens. Sync tomorrow 10am. :calendar: 

Jonah: One more: add tenant-scoping to token validation to prevent cross-tenant replay. Also log token rejects with sampling so we can monitor incorrect resumes.

Lia P: Ack. I'll include a short perf test harness and baseline numbers in the PR.

Samir: I'll push a spec draft before EOD and include examples of trailer shapes and error codes.

Maya K: Thanks all — keeping this lightweight but we need the deployment-safe defaults in place before cutover.
